description: Striking-distance queries for one website: non-branded queries at Google positions 4-20 with real impressions, ranked by what their top landing page earned (net revenue in the selected currency, then paying customers, then signups). upside_clicks is an estimate: impressions at the public position-3 CTR in ctr_target, less current clicks. Same period/from/to/time_zone/currency as analytics_snapshot.

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

granularity.description: day, week, or month; default day

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website
